Learning at Princeway College

English-medium education
with a strong foundation.

Kindergarten and primary education in Korathota, Athurugiriya, together with extra-class and Cambridge curriculum support.

Day school

Kindergarten and primary education

Princeway College provides English-medium learning shaped around Sri Lanka’s national curriculum. Our approach combines foundational knowledge with communication, curiosity, confidence and the social and emotional growth of each child.

What families can expect

  • Age-appropriate learning for kindergarten and primary learners.
  • English-medium teaching with attention to strong foundations.
  • Personal encouragement in a caring, values-led environment.
  • A focus on academic, social and emotional development.

Beyond the school day

Local-syllabus extra classes

Additional learning support is available outside regular school hours for local-syllabus students in English and Sinhala medium. Subjects, grades and timetables may change, so families should contact the school for the current schedule.

Broader pathways

Cambridge curriculum tuition support

Princeway College also supports learners following the Cambridge curriculum through private tuition. Contact the school to confirm current subjects, levels, availability and class times.
